name: com.ahmer.afzal.utils.permission.AppSettingsDialogHolderActivity
description: AhmerUtils (Ahmer Afzal) opens this Activity to explain a denied permission and launch Android’s app settings when the app needs the user to restore that permission. It returns the result to the screen that requested the dialog.
disableEffect: The app cannot show this permission-recovery dialog or open settings through this flow.
